comparison.objective: Open a pump suction valve before starting the pump; candidate adjusts a damper while isolated, then operates a guarded cycle control.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered valve and button operation versus precision hex-key/collar manipulation plus later control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Safe sequence leaves the pump running with suction open; candidate requires de-energized adjustment and two measured safe stops.
comparison.reason: Both enforce safe sequencing around energized equipment, but the pump task does not test adjustment, locking, or dynamic-response tuning.
